title: Noetherian sheaf derived completion has the quotient-tower model
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], let $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ be a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf [pqf-def-coherent], and work in the ordinary derived category $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $\Lambda_{\mathcal I}$ for the left-adjoint reflection into the locally derived $\mathcal I$-complete objects of [def-weil-pbc-locally-derived-ringed-ideal-complete], with unit $\eta$, as constructed in [lem-weil-pbc-extended-cech-completion-model]. For every $K\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ there is a canonical isomorphism $\Lambda_{\mathcal I}K\xrightarrow{\sim}R\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(K\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}^{\mathbf L}\mathcal O_X/\mathcal I^n)$ [def-weil-derived-limit]. It carries $\eta_K$ to the map induced by the compatible quotient maps. For every coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal G$ [pqf-def-coherent] there are canonical isomorphisms $\Lambda_{\mathcal I}(\mathcal G[0])\xrightarrow{\sim}R\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(\mathcal G/\mathcal I^n\mathcal G)[0]\xleftarrow{\sim}(\varprojlim_{n\geq1}\mathcal G/\mathcal I^n\mathcal G)[0]$, and the completion unit corresponds to the ordinary quotient maps. All comparisons are natural in $K$ or $\mathcal G$ and compatible with restriction to open subschemes (including the canonical identification $(\Lambda_{\mathcal I}K)|_W\cong\Lambda_{\mathcal I|_W}(K|_W)$). Derived tensor uses K-flat resolutions and sheaf derived limits use functorial K-injective tower models and derived products; ordinary sheaf products are not assumed exact.
